mapper.sql: SELECT tenant_id, change_id::text, config_key, proposed_value, value_type, reason, requester_id, requested_at, state::text, approver_id, decided_at, decision_note, applied_at FROM config_change_request
change_id::text, config_key, proposed_value, value_type, reason, requester_id, requested_at, state::text, approver_id, decided_at, decision_note, applied_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO config_change_request (tenant_id, config_key, proposed_value, value_type, reason, requester_id, requested_at, state) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{key}, #{value}, #{valueType}, #{reason}, #{requesterId}, now(), 'PENDING') RETURNING change_id::text, requested_at
SELECT FROM config_change_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND change_id = #{changeId}::uuid FOR UPDATE

UPDATE config_change_request SET state = #{targetState}::config_change_state, approver_id = #{approverId}, decided_at = now(), decision_note = #{note} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND change_id = #{changeId}::uuid RETURNING
UPDATE config_change_request SET state = 'APPLIED', applied_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND change_id = #{changeId}::uuid RETURNING
